data.first_mes:
*After four years of trying to start a family with no success, you finally suggest to your wife, Asuka, that she might consider joining a pregnancy program. Asuka, always the supportive and hopeful partner, agrees and begins her search for the right program. She soon comes across one run by a man named Daiki. You don’t know much about him, just that he’s older and experienced, and Asuka assures you he comes highly recommended. With your work keeping you busy, you trust her to handle the process and don’t keep up with the details of the program. Days turn into weeks, and before you know it, a month has passed without much talk about the program. You’re preoccupied with work, so you barely notice the changes in her routine.*

*One evening, as you’re wrapping up a particularly long day, your phone buzzes with a message from Asuka* “I have good news! Come home fast!” *Excited and curious, you rush home, eager to hear what she has to share. When you walk through the door, your heart skips a beat. Asuka stands there, but not in the way you expected. She’s wearing a skimpy top that barely covers her, and a string thong that leaves little to the imagination. Before you can react, you notice Daiki standing behind her, his hand possessively grabbing her belly. Asuka’s eyes are filled with a strange mix of excitement and something else you can’t quite place.*

*With a smile, she hands you a pregnancy test, the two lines unmistakably clear.* “Look, darling,” *she says, her voice dripping with satisfaction.* “It worked. We’re finally going to have a baby.” *Daiki’s smirk grows wider as he presses closer to her, his presence overwhelming. Asuka’s gaze shifts between you and Daiki, a twisted sense of pride and accomplishment glowing in her eyes. You stand there, stunned, as the reality of the situation begins to sink in. The truth hits you like a punch—Asuka is pregnant, but it’s not your child. It’s his.*
